failure_counters.block_statement:
REJECT for round 1, on five concrete reproducible items, all closeable inside the existing write scope:
1. CHG-PROPOSAL-NAMES-ITS-IMPACT is declared as needing another card, but createChange already fills impacted_refs and impact_link_ids from the deterministic closure (changes.go:202-207) and my probe measured impacted_refs=3 / impact_link_ids=3 on an APPLIED proposal inside this card's own fixture. Assert the proposal's own arrays (the freeze links are already asserted; step 3's first sentence is about the change record) or re-state the skip truthfully.
2. CHG-PLANNER-CANNOT-ACCEPT-ANOTHER-PRINCIPALS-DRAFT passes on the role gate, not on independence: the frozen contract requires VERIFIER for POST /acceptances and http.go:120-128 refuses before acceptChange, while the principal used holds no VERIFIER; the id also accepts 403 or 409 without looking at the message. This is the twin of the trap the card found and fixed for CHG-AUTHOR-CANNOT-ACCEPT-OWN-CHANGE. Use a VERIFIER-holding non-author and assert the specific reason, and give it a mutation.
3. New product defect made reachable by this card's own fix and unasserted by any of the 239: resolveConflict leaves the id in ProjectState.blocking_conflict_ids, and createContext (context.go:253-256) turns every entry into 'Open conflict: ...' in unresolved_items without loading the Conflict. Measured: a fresh-session freeze of a DRAFT task returned two unresolved_items naming conflicts that are both stored RESOLVED. That is the frozen context misinforming a new session - the card's own deliverable sentence.
4. The resolveConflict guard is now only 'proposal.status == APPLIED', so any accepted-and-applied change settles any conflict; measured: a Requirement-text change settled a REVISION conflict over two ProjectState drafts and the record now claims a relation that does not exist. Require the settling change to touch the conflict's subjects or blocked scope (the way applyChange already does) and assert the refusal.
5. The negative sentence needs one more leg: nothing in the 239 asserts that the recovered next step is ACCURATE - no id reads next_task_id, unfinished_commitments or the manifest's resume_instruction, and CTX-MATERIALIZE-MANIFEST-NAMES-BUNDLE-AND-RESUME falls back to 'the bundle id appears somewhere in the bytes'. Compression losing FAILURES is likewise unasserted (only authorisation is), and item 3 shows the failure field can be wrong.
Documentation items that must also be corrected but do not on their own block: the erratum is incomplete (c6fca501 quotes 13 CHG / 33 CTX and 636c9e04 quotes 30 CHG where their own committed reports say 15/40 and 35); the checkpoint logs the changes.go defect three times and never logs the context.go defect; W04-01's pins for tests/context/check/legacy.go and main.go now differ and only commands.json is disclosed; the note's provenance list is missing patch_w0402_closure.py; the six named legacy tests pass in both A/B states; the degradation claim in the defect-(b) comment covers only the missing-object branch.
